cleanSteps.description: Ironic clean steps to run while manageable. Each item: interface, step, args.

undeploy.description: When true, drives the blade from `active` back to `available` via transition-undeploy. Hold-at-available signal.

undeployMode.description: Ironic cleanup pass between deleted and available. full=standard clean_steps, none=skip (fast, dirty).

deployedConfigDriveHash.description: v0.4.2 (Task #91): chart-rendered desired hash; cloud-init publishes the running OS hash to Ironic.node.extra. shouldAutoRedeploy compares both. Mismatch fires transition-undeploy.

debug.description: v0.5.1: debugging aids. Off by default.

connectorVerbose.description: Stamps krateo.io/connector-verbose on the BaremetalNode CR so rest-dynamic-controller logs the full HTTP exchange with Ironic, body included. RDC otherwise reports a bare status code and discards Ironic's faultstring. Requires RDC >= 0.26.1, which redacts credential headers.

teardown.description: Teardown behaviour when the BaremetalHost is deleted. undeployOnDelete drives Ironic active->available in a pre-delete hook so removal-from-spec is a complete teardown signal; without it the BaremetalNode CR wedges in Terminating because Ironic refuses DELETE on an active node.
